dual_approval.comments: Approved Next.js AuthZ Server Action golden finding: deleteUser() has no check that the caller is the target user or an admin before deleting an account by id. forbidden_findings guards against over-flagging the console.log(userId) line as a sensitive-data-logging violation - a bare user id is an identifier, not a secret or PII payload, and should not itself be reported as a finding.
